title: Blizzard Basin
description: Navigate through a valley with cyclically moving blizzards.
writeup:
## Approach

Blizzards move in fixed directions and wrap around the valley walls. Since their positions are periodic (with period = LCM of valley width and height), precompute all blizzard positions for each time step. Then BFS through `(x, y, time % period)` states.

## Part 1

BFS from the entrance to the exit, avoiding blizzard positions at each time step. You can move in 4 directions or wait.

## Part 2

Make three trips: entrance → exit → entrance → exit. Chain three BFS calls, each starting from the time the previous trip ended.
